title: ranunculus longimammus
intro: Ranunculus longimammus, commonly known as the long-beaked Ranunculus, is a plant species found in the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus longimammus include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
